narrative.overview: White, product-led e-commerce composition with Dolce Look identity and real catalogue photography. Supersedes the former cinematic editorial world. An optional whole-site publication uses upright real photography, ivory paper and olive controls while retaining both shop and earlier product-only magazine. The user rejected the complete-publication composition as confusing; a separate refined edition uses direct categories, contained photos and grouped choices. Both older magazines and the white storefront remain available.
keyCharacteristics: Scoped complete ivory/olive publication with manual page turns
Refined optional edition: direct category tabs, full photographs and compact grouped choices
dos: Use authentic product data and photos.
Keep complete-magazine photos aligned and upright, and its red limited to original brand hearts.
donts: Do not invent commerce policies or prices.
Do not restore superseded cinematic styling.
